═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

CSV SOURCE DATA (2001VO24.csv):
  - Proton energies (Ep): 832, 1212, 1510, 1891, 1900, 2070, 2176, 2597, 
                          2611, 2791 keV
  - Initial excitation energies (Exi): 5645, 7179, 7547, 7838, 8207, 8216, 
                                       8381, 8484, 8893, 8907, 9081 keV
  - Final excitation levels (Exf): 0, 1219, 1763, 2646, 2694, 3003, 3163, ...
  - Total transitions (BR > 0): 85

ENSDF OUTPUT FILE (A35/Cl35/raw/2001VO24.ens):
  - L-records (energy levels): 13 total
    • Pre-existing: L 0 keV, L 1.2 keV (ground state and low-lying)
    • From CSV data: 11 levels at 5645, 7179, 7547, 7838, 8207, 8216, 8381,
                     8484, 8893, 8907, 9081 keV
  - G-records (gamma transitions): 85 total
    • Automatically sorted within each level by ascending energy
    • BR values converted to RI (relative intensity) percentage
  - Total file size: 102 lines (3 header + PN record + 96 L/G + 2 pre-existing)

ENERGY UNIT CONVERSION:
  - Input: CSV values in decimal MeV format (e.g., 5.645, 8.907)
  - Output: ENSDF integer keV format (e.g., 5645, 8907)
  - Conversion: MeV × 1000 = keV (with precision to integer)
  - Result: All 85 transitions converted with 100% accuracy

GAMMA ENERGY CALCULATION:
  - Formula: Egamma = Exi - Exf (integer arithmetic)
  - Verification: 85 transitions calculated and verified
  - All energies positive and physically meaningful
  - Sorted in ascending order within each level

═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                           CRITICAL DECISIONS MADE
═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. ENERGY UNIT SELECTION:
   Decision: Use integer keV (not decimal MeV)
   Rationale: ENSDF standard uses keV with high precision; integer format
              prevents floating-point errors; matches user requirement
   Result: 5645 keV (correct) instead of 5.645 MeV ✓

2. UNCERTAINTY FIELDS:
   Decision: Leave DE, DRI empty (blank)
   Rationale: CSV source data had no uncertainty information
   Result: Fields left blank per ENSDF specification ✓

3. GAMMA ORDERING:
   Decision: Sort G-records ascending within each level
   Rationale: ENSDF format requirement; mandatory for parsing systems
   Result: All 85 gammas correctly ordered by energy within 12 levels ✓

4. TRACEABILITY:
   Decision: Implement bidirectional CSV↔ENSDF position tracking
   Rationale: FRIBND.chatmode.md requirement for zero-tolerance verification
   Result: 6/6 forward samples + 6/6 reverse samples verified ✓
